title: synthetic-data-generator
summary: A small Python package that generates synthetic multi-table financial data (bills, categories, goals, transactions, users, goal_transactions) for a personal-finance style dataset, loading seed CSVs via SDV's CSVHandler/Metadata and configuring table-level parameters. SDV's HMASynthesizer is directly instantiated and run to synthesize the linked relational tables.
